guide.title: User Guide
guide.subtitle: A complete guide to using ZanBus
guide.label_2: From account setup to everyday travel
guide.desc_1: Register with your full name and phone number. Your ZanBus card is created for you right away.
guide.desc_2: To sign in, enter your phone number, then the 6-digit code we send you. No password to remember.
guide.desc_3: On the home page, tap your card to flip it. Use the eye icon to show or hide your balance.
guide.desc_4: Tap Top Up, choose your own card or another card, enter an amount, then proceed to payment.
guide.desc_5: When you board, open Use Card and scan the code to take the ride.
guide.desc_6: Open Transaction history in Settings to see your top-ups and rides at any time.
guide.desc_7: If your card is lost or stolen, tap Report Loss on the home page right away.
guide.desc_8: Need a hand? Visit Help & Support in Settings to read the help center, contact the team or report a problem.

faq.title: FAQs
faq.subtitle: Answers about accounts, cards, payments, travel, and lost cards.
faq.q1: How do I create a ZanBus account?
faq.a1: Tap Register on the welcome page, enter your full name and phone number, and your ZanBus card is created for you right away. If you already have a card, choose “I have a physical card” and sign in.
faq.a2: Enter your phone number and tap Send code. We send you a 4-digit code, and you enter it to sign in. There is no password to remember.
faq.q3: How do I top up my card?
faq.a3: Open Top Up from the home page, choose your card, enter an amount (or pick a quick amount such as 1,000, 5,000 or 10,000) and tap Proceed to Payment.
faq.q4: Can I top up someone else’s card?
faq.a4: Yes. On the Top Up page switch to the Another card tab, type the card number, enter the amount and continue to payment.
faq.q5: How do I pay for a ride?
faq.a5: Open Use Card and show your QR code to the bus conductor to scan. Make sure your card has enough balance before you board. NFC tap-to-pay is coming soon.
faq.q6: Where can I see my balance and past payments?
faq.a6: Your balance is on the card on the home page. Tap the eye icon to show or hide it. For past top-ups and rides, open Transaction history in Settings.
faq.q7: What should I do if I lose my card?
faq.a7: Tap Report Loss on the home page, select the card and confirm. The card is blocked straight away and cannot be used again. A replacement is issued at the GRT Main Office in Kijangwani.
faq.a8: Open Settings and tap Help Center to call or email our support team. You can also read the User Guide for a step-by-step walkthrough of the app.
